newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED AGAINST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED AGAINST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished Monday trade mixed against hard currencies after a fairly dull interbank session, dealers said.
"We had a few deals here and there but nothing to write home about. It wasn't an interesting market today," one dealer commented.
At Monday's close, the local dollar was quoted at 10.0900/1200 versus the U.S. dollar, a notch up on Friday's 10.1000/1300.

On the crosses, it weakened against sterling to 15.7050/7610 from 15.6980/7510, in response to the U.S. dollar's marginal losses on that unit abroad, and was also softer on the mark at 6.8280/8500 compared to 6.7890/8120.
Against the rand, however, it held steady at 2.2220/2310. --Stella Mapenzauswa, Harare Newsroom: +263-4 72 52 27/8/9---
